_doc: The campaign's dock beat alone (a check of ScriptedCaptain.Dock): a new Concord campaign, to your own port, every ship repaired that can be paid for, and a ship bought at the shipyard when the credits allow it after a reserve (owner, 2026-11-11: "when ship gets damaged you dont get auto repair, you have to pay to repair your ship", "buy new ships or upgrade current one, I'll leave it up to you").
